methodology.impactNote: Reviewed for the exact-configuration campaign migration. The methodology retains the same 29 analytical obligations and numerical reductions. The campaign identity contract now binds each source by assemblyId and modelRevisionSha256, uses factual source slugs and geometry-coordinate names, and does not reconstruct a parent-family taxonomy. Compact Monte Carlo rows remain diagnostic, omit acceptance-bearing raw evidence, and cannot enter accepted_case until rerun through the full independently checked protocol.
